text.en:
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Price Control and Anti -Profiteering
(Determination of Maximum Price) (No. 7) Order 2024.

 (2) This Order has effect for the period fr om 23 December  2024
to 27 December 2024.

Maximum producer price

2. The maximum producer price for the price -controlled goods specified
in column (1) of the F irst Schedule for the State of Sabah , the State of  Sarawak and
the Federal Territor y of  Labuan is determin ed according to the areas and districts
as specified in column (2).

Maximum wholesale price

3. The maximum wholesale price for the price -controlled goods specified
in column (1) of the Second Schedule for  Peninsular Malaysia,  the State of Sabah,
the State of Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan is determined according
to the areas and districts as specified in column (2).

Maximum retail price

4. The maximum retail price for the price -controlled goods specified in column (1)
of the Third Schedule for the Peninsular Malaysia, the State of  Sabah,
the State of Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan is determi ned according
to the areas and districts as specified in column (2).
